svg.title: Progress since the first commit
svg.desc: Oct 7: First commit. Oct 8: Lineage-carrying tables, curation, export. Oct 9: Rights vocabulary, grounded synthesis, sandboxed parsers. Oct 10: Judge and proxy-student loop. Nov 1: 12-file Korean, English and French corpus. Nov 2: Vision OCR escalation, Korean PDF repairs. Nov 3: Unsloth and NeMo Curator baselines, signed export. Nov 3: Evaluation protocol committed before any run. Nov 4: Figures stage; 5 of 6 folds scored. Next: Fold 6, seeds 1-2, judge calibration, external pilot.
